Then a light gust ripples through the trees, and the droplets begin to vibrate, merging into thin streams that glide down the beak and along the feathers. Finally, the clouds open just enough for a brighter ribbon of light to land on the statue’s head, making the wet pavement flare into gold-and-blue reflections like polished glass.
